response.original_title: CBS TRIES THE NEW YORK THREE (NY3): RACIST LIES ON PRIME TIME TV
response.overview: Is the CBS docudrama “The Badge of the Assassin” a blatant distortion of a true story? Yes! Is the conviction of the New York Three (NY3) (members of the Black Panther Party) a total miscarriage of justice? Yes! Safiya Bukhari-Alston, Brian Glick and the New York Three (NY3) discuss the Black Panther Party and how an extensive series of covert operations were able to undermine a movement.
response.title: CBS TRIES THE NEW YORK THREE (NY3): RACIST LIES ON PRIME TIME TV
